definitions.explanation: The hard structures in the mouth used for biting and chewing. Used for dental care, physical descriptions, and tooth-related expressions.

examples.japanese: {歯|は}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{歯|は}{医者|いしゃ}→歯医者：01696_haisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きます→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: My tooth hurts, so I'm going to the dentist.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{歯|は}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}けました→抜ける：02385_nukeru⟧。
⟦{歯|は}{医者|いしゃ}→歯医者：01696_haisha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{歯|は}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦もらいました→もらう：00520_morau⟧。

notes:
{歯|は} refers to tooth/teeth, used in dental care, physical descriptions, and idioms.

- {歯|は}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧: tooth hurts
- {歯|は}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}ける→抜ける：02385_nukeru⟧: tooth falls out
{歯|は}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}たない→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: to be no match for (lit. 'teeth can't stand')
